AUTHORITY: PI, 2026-09-10: 'Separation metric: use the existing in-repo JSD machinery if it is already tested and stable. That is preferable to inventing a new divergence implementation under deadline.'

CHANGE.from: L_sep = -clip(KL(pi_i || stopgrad(pi_sib)), max=2.0 nats), hand-rolled per-head KL written for this SPEC
CHANGE.to: L_sep = -JSD(pi_i, stopgrad(pi_sib)) using rl/teacher_distillation.py::jsd_per_head over rl/custom_ppo/strategy_anchor.py::_masked_heads, averaged by rl/teacher_distillation.py::masked_mean over decision-eligible agent-heads (rl/custom_ppo/exp2_teacher_compression.py::decision_eligible_agents)
CHANGE.config_field_removed: sibling_sep_kl_clip (obsolete: JSD is bounded by ln 2 = 0.6931 nats, so no ad-hoc clip is needed)

WHY: jsd_per_head is pre-existing, in-repo, and already used on the distillation fidelity path -- not a new divergence implementation authored under deadline

JSD is symmetric and bounded in [0, ln 2], so the separation term cannot dominate the PPO surrogate through an unbounded tail; the arbitrary 2.0-nat clip disappears rather than becoming a second untested hyperparameter
head_logits applies the SAME legality masking PPO's own update evaluates, so separation pressure acts on the distribution PPO optimizes rather than an unmasked surrogate
masked_mean restricts numerator and denominator to decision-eligible agent-heads (blue_commit_ticks_left <= 0), matching the disagreement mask's own decision-point definition

UNCHANGED_BY_THIS_AMENDMENT.cadence: 1 separation step per 4 completed PPO actor minibatches, separate zero_grad/backward/step
UNCHANGED_BY_THIS_AMENDMENT.sibling_source: frozen opposite-pole VANILLA B3 final, stop-grad
UNCHANGED_BY_THIS_AMENDMENT.mask: prospectively fixed GUARD/BREACH scripted disagreement states; NOT derived from the new learned policies

TIMING_INTEGRITY: No training seed and no sealed crossover seed had been spent when this amendment was written. The disagreement-dataset collection (16810001..16810064) was in progress; that block carries no policy gradient and no gate outcome, so the divergence definition was still prospective.
FAILURE_POLICY_RESTATED: A FAIL remains a FAIL. lambda, mask definition, divergence, and checkpoint rule may not be revised in response to the sealed crossover outcome.
